rows.quote: METHODS: We conducted two-sample MR using protein quantitative trait loci from 54,219 UK Biobank participants and summary-level association results from up to 11,114 EOS cases (onset <60 years) and 435,540 controls in the Early-Onset Stroke Consortium.
rows.coder_note: The sentence names the Early-Onset Stroke Consortium as the source of the outcome summary statistics; the dictionary has no row for it (its stroke rows are other consortia with other counts).
The stated participant count (54,219) equals no candidate row's sample size; no platform, subcohort or citation.
